independent_verification_method: Hash recomputation (plan text above deviation log unchanged; code hashes unchanged); chronology from mtimes and transcript timestamps

Say 'pre-specified and internally frozen' and disclose.

claim: 'Six-origin evaluation' ... horizons of 7 and 28 days
independent_verification_method: Read windows from config; recompute block membership of every row
required_correction_or_qualification: Verified: 6 retraining blocks of 28 days per cell (24 weekly blocks). But for H=7/28 the 'horizon' is the minimum feature lag: every target day is forecast from data >= H days old; for H=7 forecast origins are daily. Define 'origin', 'block' and 'horizon' explicitly; do not call the six blocks 'forecast origins' without that definition.

claim: Confirmatory estimand: relative pooled-WAPE change vs best validation baseline; crossed bootstrap; Holm over six tests
independent_verification_method: Formula recomputed independently; independent bootstrap + two-way cluster-robust delta method reproduce estimates, CIs and verdicts
required_correction_or_qualification: Report that the crossed bootstrap is an approximation (simulated coverage 0.90-0.93 for a nominal 0.95 with 24 week blocks).

claim: H1 contradicted in three cells (-3.7% to -11.4%; Holm p <= 0.016), inconclusive in three (-2.6% to -3.7%)
independent_verification_method: Independent decisions under the frozen rule: identical for all 6 cells under bootstrap and under the delta method
required_correction_or_qualification: Holm p printed as '<0.001' for TX_1/other cells exceeds the resolution of a 2000-draw bootstrap (min raw p 0.0005, x up to 6 under Holm): write '<0.003' or use an analytic/larger-B p-value.

claim: The best baseline was always a trailing 28-day median
independent_verification_method: Read selection files; recompute pooled WAPE ranking of all 21 methods
required_correction_or_qualification: None. Note the choice is made on validation WAPE, itself a median-favouring metric.

claim: Median baseline 'forecasts close to zero for sparse series (relative bias -0.28 to -0.58)'
independent_verification_method: Bias recomputed; share of exactly-zero forecasts by cell and segment
required_correction_or_qualification: Bias range verified. 'Close to zero' is true for M5 (zero forecasts on 55-69% of rows, 30-42% of positive-demand rows) but not for Online Retail II (15-18% zero forecasts): its -0.55...-0.58 bias comes from right-skewed demand (median << mean), not zero forecasts.

claim: Store-day aggregate WAPE 0.08-0.11 (model) vs 0.29-0.35 (median) on M5
independent_verification_method: Recomputed from stored predictions; identity aggregate WAPE >= |relative bias| checked
required_correction_or_qualification: Numbers verified. 'Store-day' is wrong: the aggregate is over the 350-series (M5) or 100-SKU (OR II) subset, not the store. The reversal is largely arithmetic: the median's aggregate WAPE exceeds its |bias| by only 0.008 on M5, and the ranking already reverses at item-week level in all six cells.

claim: Post-hoc L1 refit matched or beat the median baseline in pooled WAPE but lost the aggregate advantage
independent_verification_method: Independent recomputation of E1 metrics and CIs (step8)
required_correction_or_qualification: Numbers verified and correctly labelled post hoc. Qualify: vs the matched baseline it won on 2 of 3 datasets (TX_1 tie); vs the best (fresh) baseline it only tied on M5; the aggregate advantage was lost on M5 but not on Online Retail II (0.523 vs 0.730).

claim: Calendar and history-statistic features helped (+2.6%, +3.5% when removed); price and identifiers did not measurably
independent_verification_method: Independent recomputation of the four ablations (step8); features removed checked in config files
required_correction_or_qualification: Verified for M5 CA_1, H=28 only and exploratory; the abstract omits both qualifiers. Holm p '<0.001' is below bootstrap resolution (independent Holm p = 0.002 at the floor).

claim: 80% conformal intervals covered 79-81% overall but under-covered frequent series
independent_verification_method: Independent Mondrian conformal implementation; coverage by block, segment, zero/positive demand
required_correction_or_qualification: Verified numerically, but the marginal coverage is carried by zero-demand rows: coverage on zero-demand rows 85-94%, on positive-demand rows 60-67% on M5 (79% on Online Retail II). Report coverage separately for zero and positive demand; do not present 'near-nominal' coverage as calibration.

claim: Best classifier beat a recency baseline in ROC-AUC at both origins (+0.028, +0.037)
independent_verification_method: Labels and recency re-derived from raw transactions; AUC/AP, paired customer bootstrap and Holm recomputed
required_correction_or_qualification: Numbers verified. The two origins share 94% of test customers (label correlation 0.40), so they are not independent replications; the PR-AUC gain at origin A is +0.010 and the customer-split check at A is not significant; practical gain at fixed contact budgets is 0-2 points of precision.

claim: A calibrator fitted on validation worsened calibration when prevalence shifted
independent_verification_method: Mean predictions vs prevalence; diagnostic intercept shift using test labels
required_correction_or_qualification: Verified: at origin B an oracle intercept shift of -0.80 logits reduces Platt ECE from 0.126 to 0.019, consistent with prevalence shift (diagnostic only).
